plan.title: Oak Bowl: Finished First, Then How It's Made
plan.summary: Opens on the finished oak bowl, then traces the making steps from raw blank to lathe shaping, sanding, and oiling.

segments.label: finished oak bowl on table
segments.reason: Top-down view of smooth finished bowl with concentric grain on dark planks is visible throughout; speech [0.0-5.0] states 'This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table.'; end moved back to sentence boundary at 4.6 s.

segments.label: raw oak blank close-up
segments.reason: Blurry close-up of rough wood cross-section with wavy growth rings is visible; speech [8.0-12.0] states 'Here is the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy.'

segments.label: bowl shape forming on lathe
segments.reason: Bowl with tool at rim and shavings visible as shape is cut; speech [16.0-20.0] states 'On the lathe the shape appears in long, steady cuts.'

segments.label: sanding the turning bowl
segments.reason: Continued turning view with tool contact and surface refinement visible; speech [24.0-29.0] states 'Sanding goes from coarse to fine, with the lathe turning slowly.'

segments.label: oiled surface detail
segments.reason: Tool removed, clean bowl with warm glowing grain visible top-down; speech [32.0-36.0] states 'A coat of food safe oil brings out the color.'

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.

review.caption_suggestion: Finished oak bowl first, then how it's made — blank to lathe to oil.
strengths: Opens exactly on brief with finished bowl at 0.00s
Clear reverse-story logic: hero then raw blank to oiled detail
Tight 21.6s runtime respects 25s ceiling and keeps momentum
